presets.name: Candlelit tiptoe dance
presets.description: A short fairy-tale dance with small steps on raised heels.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded image as the identity reference for one adult dancer or fictional character. Preserve the same face, hairstyle, clothing colors and recognizable design. Show the dancer's entire body and both shoes from head to toe in a candlelit rustic fairy-tale room, with wooden beams, a little straw along the walls and a clear wooden floor. One continuous four-second shot, stationary camera, no cuts. From the first frame the dancer lifts both heels high and balances on the balls of the feet. Keeping the heels visibly raised, take four tiny alternating prancing steps sideways, with bent knees and elbows tucked playfully near the waist. Finish balanced on tiptoe. The soles and lifted heels must remain visible throughout; leave floor space below the shoes. Natural leg joints, exactly two legs and two feet, stable face and costume, no morphing, no extra people, no spinning, no props, no text or logos. Silent video.
